20261119-physics-e6.material: Kedu n'ime nkọwa ndị a gbasara ntụnyere circuit nwere bọlb abụọ yiri ibe ha jikọtara n'usoro (series) na nke jikọtara n'otu ụzọ (parallel) ziri ezi?

20261119-physics-e6.s.s1.prompt: Kedu n'ime nkọwa ndị a gbasara ntụnyere circuit nwere bọlb abụọ yiri ibe ha jikọtara n'usoro (series) na nke jikọtara n'otu ụzọ (parallel) ziri ezi?
20261119-physics-e6.s.s1.explain: Mgbe e jikọtara bọlb parallel, voltage zuru ezu nke batrị na-agbado bọlb ọ bụla, ya mere ha na-enwu karịa, ọbụlagodi ma otu bọlb gbajiri, circuit nke bọlb ndị ọzọ na-anọgide.
